name: Floating Action Menu Expansion
composition: Compact circular trigger button expanding vertically into a pill-shaped stack of sub-actions.
focal_point: Primary trigger icon transitioning from plus (+) to close (X) while items pop out.
layout_behavior: Absolute floating bottom-right container, z-index elevated above main scroll content.
typography_characteristics: Small crisp labels (12px-14px, medium weight) appearing adjacent to sub-icons.
choreography: Trigger rotates 45deg (0-150ms). Sub-items pop out sequentially with 40ms stagger delay.
perceived_physics: Snappy, elastic pop with subtle overshooting scale on entrance (scale 1.05 -> 1.0).
interaction_model: Click or key press toggles open/close state. Outside click auto-dismisses.
visual_hierarchy: Trigger has highest contrast; sub-menu items use muted background fills.
why_it_works: Staggered spring motion guides the eye along the action list sequentially without overwhelming.
avoid_when: Forms requiring multiple visible simultaneous inputs
accessibility: Requires aria-expanded on trigger, aria-hidden when closed, and full arrow-key focus trap.
responsive: Positions safely above bottom mobile safe area (padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).
performance: 100% GPU accelerated. Uses transform and opacity only.
web_implementation_strategy: Framer Motion AnimatePresence with variants staggerChildren: 0.04.
portfolio_applications: Floating contact dock or quick navigation launcher in portfolio hero.
notes: Directly observed from Jitter UI elements collection; transcribed to Framer Motion recipe.

name: Side Rail Menu Slide
composition: Vertical navigation rail sliding out smoothly from screen edge with translucent background.
focal_point: Active navigation item highlight shifting position.
typography_characteristics: Sans-serif medium weight (14px) with uppercase muted category headers.
choreography: Rail slides in (200ms). Backdrop overlay fades in parallel (150ms). Items stagger-fade.
perceived_physics: Smooth decelerated slide like a physical drawer.
interaction_model: Hamburger button trigger or swipe gesture.
visual_hierarchy: Active route item uses solid background pill; inactive items remain muted text.
why_it_works: Clear spatial origin; users immediately understand where the menu came from.
avoid_when: Widescreen desktop views where persistent sidebar fits natively
accessibility: Requires modal dialog ARIA role, focus trap, and Escape key listener.
responsive: Converts to persistent column layout on screens >= 1024px.
web_implementation_strategy: Tailwind CSS transition-transform or Framer Motion drawer.
portfolio_applications: Mobile case study drawer or portfolio filter drawer.
notes: Observed from Jitter navigation template suite.
